# `jouet claim ls`

- **Usage:** `jouet claim ls [--all]`

List the live claims in this repository, every session's

Claims that expired, or whose worktree or agent is gone, are removed first; --all lists them before they go.

## Flags
- **`--all`** — Also list the claims that no longer hold
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
